text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out shopping for training gear
with Buena Vista...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
...Is that...

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle is underway~!
The grand prize is an all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!
2nd prize is "Mountain of Carrots"!
3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the fun, fun lottery!
Anyone and everyone, come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Wah, a hot springs trip...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
We used to go on family trips together
all the time back then, too.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...If I win,
I wonder if we can all go together again?
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had gotten a lottery ticket from shopping earlier.
Just as I was about to hand it to Buena Vista—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Then... Trainer, would you
spin it together with me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
If we join our forces together...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm sure I can get my hands on anything.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista places her hand over mine...
and together, we enthusiastically turned the lottery crank!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!!
The Grand Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...!
I won!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
A hot springs trip!
...Eep!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
T-Tears!? Did you want to win that badly?
But why...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Just thinking that the people I care about
might be happy made me...!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... Those tears are...
for the sake of the people you cherish... Ugh, UWAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Are you... 
crying for my sake...?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You are far too kind...
...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry about earlier...
choice_data_list: Glad you've calmed down. Shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Doesn't it bother you,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "My emotions get swayed so easily. Don't you think I act just like a child?"
choice_data_list: Because that's just who you are.
Because that's just who you are.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...That is true, but.
I just wonder if it might be a little over the top."
choice_data_list: It's proof of your rich sensitivity. There's nothing weird about it!
It just proves how deeply you feel things. It's not weird at all.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's not it...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"No.
I'm okay, it's nothing."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, about that hot spring trip...
With our current schedule, going right away might be tough.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I want to focus for a while, so...
Trainer, could you hold onto this for me?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Whenever you have time to relax,
just reach out... and let's all go together.
Just like old times!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can't wait!
...Let's do our best until then.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Thinking of reaching out to her and her family
once things settled down after the race...
I took the hot spring trip ticket and tucked it safely away.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~!
The prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
It's first prize, first prize!
Your power really is incredible after all, Trainer♪
choice_data_list: No, no, it was your luck.
No, no, that was all your luck

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: No way, it was definitely thanks to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you're really close with your Trainer, huh.
Just like siblings.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
choice_data_list: I get told that a lot.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Um, so that means...
I really am the younger sister, right?"

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: Ah, of course! Man, if I really had such a cute little sister, life would definitely be a lot more exciting.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"...Right, you're right.
Little sister..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Lunch the next day. Buena Vista said
she made lunch for me, so as I was
waiting for her...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—Ta-da, my special deluxe hamburg steak twist!
It's an 'Adult Lunch Set'!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
You know how kids' meal sets are a thing?
I tried imagining an adult version of that!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
From the choice of side dishes to the seasoning...
I made sure it's refined and grown-up.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you'll love it, Trainer!
...May I have the same thing as well?

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
—*Munch*... Mmm. Delicious♪
...It has this mature taste that's simply the best!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!!
The prize is a "Mountain of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
To receive this much!
The folks from the shopping district are so generous!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Well, I just want everyone to have a good time.
You make sure to enjoy yourself to the fullest too, Buena-chan!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
My friends and I will enjoy it together♪
choice_data_list: (So she's a friend of Buena's, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She has many friends.
Thinking of all their faces, the next day arrived—

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Everyone. Thank you so much for coming
to the Carrot Party todayâª

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
I made plenty of food,
so please enjoy yourself! ♪

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I am honored by your invitation.
To share a meal with such distinguished guests—
wouldn't you agree?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, truly. Buena's popularity and charisma
are really incredible, aren't they?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whew...
That was intense.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Now, everyone, let's gather around the table...
and chat to our hearts' content♪

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
3rd prize~!
The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Buena-chan...
I can only give ya one.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Not at all, that's just how the lottery goes!
Besides, it's so glossy and looks super tasty♪

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
shall we split it in half?

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! In that case,
let this old man tweak it just a bit for ya!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: Fufu, it looks even more delicious now!
choice_data_list: Somehow, this reminds me of summer festivals from the past.

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
That's true! Hey, do you remember?
Right when we were about to order, the chocolate bananas
sold out right in front of us...

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
And then, the food stall guy whipped up
some chocolate pineapple for us on the spot.
We shared that together too, remember?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, sharing a single carrot between the two of us,
we let our fond memories blossom into conversation.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost!
Your consolation prize is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~!
No way~...!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ......Even though you lent me your strength, Trainer-san......

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Ah! No!
You've got real power, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"So what's lacking is...
my own strength..."

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh.
Maybe I just don't have the luck you deserve.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Buena Vista was deeply disappointed
after drawing a losing ticket.
